findings.expected: Java: the right-button binding (breakBlock) enters breaking mode and a right-drag breaks every non-air tile in the rect (DesktopInput.java:743). Config/inventory open on the LEFT tap, and the inventory only when build.block.hasItems && items.total() > 0 (InputHandler.java:2017).
findings.actual: Godot: right-press on a placed conveyor (or a duo turret) opens OverlayLayer/block_inventory at the tile (empty grid: only the close X, items JSON hardcoded "{}") instead of starting a break; a 6-tile right-drag over conveyors x=10..15,y=16 leaves all 6 placed. A copper-wall control line right-drags/breaks normally (6 -> 0), so the break path itself works only for has_items==false blocks.
findings.repro: scenario input_controls (Godot leg): select conveyor, left-drag tiles x=10..15 y=16, then right-drag the same line; get_state_json() still lists all 6 conveyor tiles and OverlayLayer/block_inventory.visible==true
notes: screenshots: runs/l7-20261007-074043-input_controls/godot/step-01-rightclick-empty-inventory.png, runs/l7-20261007-074043-input_controls/godot/step-03-placed-blocks-after-failed-right-drag.png. Cause seam: desktop.rs right_press() consults config_spec/has_items_at before begin_break; has_items_at = def.has_items && def.item_capacity>0 with no items.total()>0 guard, so any item-capacity block diverts to inventory. Distinct from the known missing item_stacks_json feed.
